skills: Select and integrate foundation models on Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker AI; cross-region inference; provisioned throughput
Build RAG: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, metadata filtering, reranking
Prepare and govern data for gen AI: PII handling, lineage, residency, compliance

domains.name: Implementation and Integration
skills: Build agents and tool use with Amazon Bedrock Agents / AgentCore, action groups, MCP

Defend against prompt injection and data exfiltration; least-privilege IAM, VPC endpoints, encryption
Governance: model evaluation records, audit logging (CloudTrail, invocation logging), responsible-AI controls

domains.name: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications

Monitor with CloudWatch metrics and invocation logs; quotas and throttling

domains.name: Testing, Validation, and Troubleshooting
